subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows after resolving the current merge conflict?
rationale: The code and proof support the fix, but the PR intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility in an A2A announce path, and green CI cannot fully settle whether the suppression boundary is the desired product/runtime contract for every channel history.

options.title: Accept Boundary After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the conflict against current main, preserve existing wait-failure behavior, and land after exact-head checks because the fix targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode narrowly.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the branch open and ask for a redacted WhatsApp or equivalent live-channel run if maintainers need production-channel evidence beyond the deterministic QA harness.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction-related duplicate fixes coordinated as one A2A delivery plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict against current main, preserve existing wait-failure behavior, and land after exact-head checks because the fix targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode narrowly.
